question: What is the meaning of delivery companies in relation to delivery and construction?
description: Delivery companies are not directly mentioned in the provided context. However, in the context of construction, delivery companies might refer to companies that specialize in delivering construction materials or equipment to construction sites. This could include companies that transport building materials, machinery, or other necessary items for construction projects. The specific role of delivery companies in construction would depend on the project's requirements and the services offered by the companies.

It is therefore necessary to render relevant provisions applicable also to these services and their providers.
(9)
To create the necessary link between construction products and the construction works, including buildings, into 
which they might be incorporated, the notion of construction works should be defined only for the purposes of this 
Regulation and without prejudice to Member States’ competences to define and regulate construction works and 
buildings.
(10)
In order to avoid innovative distribution models being used to circumvent the obligations under this Regulation, it 
should be clarified that any supply of a product in the course of a commercial activity, including when ownership or 
possession of the products is transferred as part of the provision of a service, would be considered as the product 
being made available on the market.
(11)
Ensuring the free movement of kits for construction products on the internal market would support industry 
competitiveness. This approach would expand market reach, streamline production processes for companies, and 
improve convenience for both consumers and businesses.
